target.title: fix(ai): preserve thinking blocks on historical turns with tool calls
target.body:
> [!NOTE]
> **AI-Assisted Contribution:** This PR was prepared and validated with the assistance of an AI coding assistant (Antigravity/Gemini).

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where omission of history thinking blocks on assistant turns with tool calls causes anthropic api rejection (pr #100915).

**Symptom/Behavior:**
The code omits `thinking` blocks for all turns other than `activeToolTurnAssistantIndex`. For historical assistant messages containing a `toolCall` block, this leaves the assistant message containing *only* `tool_use` blocks. This triggers a validation failure and API rejection (`invalid_request_error: assistant message must contain a thinking block when using a thinking model`).

Affected location: `[packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts](file://packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts#L1408-L1411)`

## Why This Change Was Made

Implemented a surgical fix to resolve the logic discrepancy.

**Solution Overview:**
Do not omit `thinking` blocks in the assistant turn if that turn also contains one or more `toolCall`/`tool_use` blocks:
  ```typescript
  if (!replayThinkingEnabled && i !== activeToolTurnAssistantIndex) {
    const hasToolCall = msg.content.some(block => block.type === "toolCall");
    if (!hasToolCall) {
      omittedThinking = true;
      continue;
    }
  }
  ```

---

## User Impact

Corrects behavior to ensure that: When replaying assistant turns in conversation history with `replayThinkingEnabled` set to `false` (to save token cost), we should only omit/strip `thinking` blocks if doing so does not violate the Anthropic API constraints. Specifically, Anthropic requires any assistant message containing `tool_use` blocks to also contain a `thinking` block when thinking is enabled on the model.

## Evidence

<!-- Unit tests and validation logs -->

- Reproduction tests run successfully.

### Real Behavior Proof

- Expected

+ false

    2049|     );
    2050|     expect(hasThinking).toBe(true);
       |                         ^
    2051|   });
```
